description: This file defines the TraceControl class for a WPEFramework plugin, which manages trace logging, categories, remote connections, and web interface integration. It includes nested classes for trace sources, observers, and data structures, and declares plugin lifecycle methods, web request handlers, and internal utilities.

classes.name: TraceControl
classes.description: Main plugin class managing trace control, including Web API integration, trace source management, and plugin lifecycle.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer
classes.description: Handles remote connection notifications, trace data observation, and background thread processing for trace data collection and dispatch.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer::Source
classes.description: Represents a trace data source, supporting load, retrieval, and reset of trace entries from cyclic buffers.

classes.name: TraceControl::Observer::ModuleIterator
classes.description: Iterates over loaded trace sources, organizes categories by module, and provides enumeration facilities.

classes.name: TraceControl::InformationWrapper
classes.description: Wraps trace source information for JSON serialization, exposing category, module, and data details.

classes.name: TraceControl::NetworkNode
classes.description: Represents network configuration for the trace control web interface (port, binding).

classes.name: TraceControl::Config
classes.description: Configuration structure for enabling/disabling console logging, syslog, abbreviated output, and remote logging.

classes.name: TraceControl::Data
classes.description: Data structure representing trace settings, including current status of modules/categories.

classes.name: TraceControl::StatusParam
classes.description: JSON structure for status query parameters specifying module and category.

classes.name: TraceControl::Trace
classes.description: JSON representation of individual trace module/category status.

classes.name: TraceControl::InformationWrapper
classes.description: Provides JSON interface to trace source information.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with service context, loads configuration, registers web endpoints.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters web endpoints, prepares plugin for unload.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles incoming web requests, parsing request data.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches trace source information to web clients.

methods.name: RegisterAll
methods.description: Registers web endpoints and plugin hooks.

methods.name: UnregisterAll
methods.description: Unregisters web endpoints and cleans up resources.

methods.name: TranslateState
methods.description: Converts internal enum to web API state type.

methods.name: endpoint_status
methods.description: Handles web API call to retrieve status of trace modules and categories.

methods.name: endpoint_set
methods.description: Handles web API call to set trace module/category states.
